title: UniPoolerV2.pool zap relies solely on keeper-supplied spot-derived floors (minPhusdOut/minLP) with addLiquidity mins 0/0: tolerance-bounded sandwich of protocol-owned liquidity on every call (successor instance of L-06)
description: ECON-001 (quantified: extraction ~0.44*t*Delta, e.g. $1,000 zap -> $2.21/$4.43/$8.87/$13.34 at t=0.5/1/2/3%; front-run capital $54-$338; gas ~$0.08; protocol owns ~100% of LP so searcher profit == protocol loss). LOCAL-UP-003 contributes: non-zero check is nominal (1 passes), minPhusdOut is the binding floor under adverse front-run. PATTERN-001 contributes the signature evidence.
impact: Protocol-owned liquidity only: per-zap extraction ~0.44*t*Delta (ECON-001: $1,000 zap -> $2.21/$4.43/$8.87/$13.34 at t = 0.5/1/2/3%). Protocol owns ~100% of LP post-cutover, so searcher profit == protocol loss. No user funds.
attackPath: 1. Searcher observes public keeper pool(sUSDSIn, minPhusdOut, minLP)
2. Front-runs with sUSDS->phUSD buy, moving price up to the keeper tolerance
3. Keeper swap+addLiquidity executes at worse price; floors pass
likelihood: medium - every public keeper call is sandwichable, but extraction is capped by keeper-chosen tolerance
assumptions: Keeper submits publicly with tolerance t; addLiquidity mins are 0/0 by design
severityJustification: Bounded, keeper-controlled MEV on POL; successor instance of open Low L-06 on the same pattern. Not Medium: loss per event is capped by an operator parameter and eliminated by private submission.
recommendation: Operational: tolerance <= 0.5% (quotePool exact under synced reserves — P5 PASS), private submission, chunk zaps. Optional caller-supplied deadline (see DEDUP-20-06).
ledgerMatch: None by fingerprint. Successor instance of L-06 342075dfba (open, BalancerPoolerV2.pool keeper-floor-only LP-add). Related class to L-03 e29ae08ed9 (fixed, BalancerPoolerV2 limitRaw=0) — new code on a new contract, not a reappearance of L-03's fixed code, so not a regression.
